name: @hardware-pos/print-agent
description: On-site print agent: drains the AxloPOS print queue to printers on the shop LAN.

scripts.//agent: Deliberately NOT named `dev`: the agent is an on-site daemon, not part of the dev stack. `turbo run dev` would start it with the API and web, where it exits immediately for want of a token and takes the whole run down. Run it explicitly with `pnpm dev:agent` when testing the cloud transport.
scripts.lint: echo "(the agent is linted by tsc; no ESLint config needed for 2 files)"
